agents.error.self_escalation: an agent cannot escalate to itself
agents.error.tier_order: min_tier must not be above max_tier
agents.error.tier_order_field: {field}: min_tier must not be above max_tier
agents.error.duplicate_id: Agent id '{id}' is defined twice in {directory}: {first} and {second}
agents.error.symlink_escape: Refusing to follow {file}: it points outside the scanned directory ({target})
agents.error.widen: {field}: the ancestor '{ancestor}' sets a permission ceiling; a descendant may narrow its permissions but not widen them
agents.error.mutating_tool: {field}: a tool that changes files (Edit, Write, MultiEdit or NotebookEdit, also in a scoped form such as Write(*)) is allowed but permissions.may_mutate is false
agents.error.override_id: {field}: a new agent needs an id
agents.error.override_extends: {field}: set by the template, do not override it
agents.error.unresolved: Agent '{id}' must be resolved (extends applied) before export
agents.error.unsafe_id: Refusing to export agent id '{id}': it is not a safe file name
agents.cmd.help: List, inspect, validate, create and export agent specs.
agents.cmd.create.help: Create a new agent from a template.
agents.cmd.export.help: Export agents as Claude Code subagent files.
agents.cmd.dir: Extra directory of agent specs (repeatable; later ones override earlier, but none may reuse a built-in agent id unless agents.allow_override is set).
agents.cmd.resolved: Show the spec with its extends chain applied.
agents.cmd.path: Path to the agent spec JSON file.
agents.cmd.template: Id of the template or agent to extend.
agents.cmd.set: Override a field as key=value (dots nest, values may be JSON). Repeatable.
agents.cmd.out_file: Write the new spec to this .json file, inside the repository root.
agents.cmd.force: Overwrite the output file if it exists and already is an agent spec.
agents.cmd.export_id: Agent id to export (repeatable). Default: every non-template agent.
agents.cmd.out_dir: Directory inside the repository root to write <id>.md files into (never .git or .claude, except .claude/agents).
agents.cmd.lang: Language of the exported text (en or pt-BR).
agents.export.generated: Generated from {source}. Do not edit by hand.
agents.export.max_risk: Highest risk you may handle without escalating: {value}
agents.export.contract: End every task with exactly one status: completed and verified, partially completed, blocked, or not executed. Back the status with evidence: commands you ran and their results, or files and lines you inspected. Never claim a result you did not verify. Do not delegate to other agents; if you cannot do something, say so and hand it back to the caller.
agents.warning.not_object: Skipped {file}: it is not a JSON object, so it is not an agent spec.
agents.warning.not_spec: Skipped {file}: it has neither 'schema_version' nor 'id', so it is not an agent spec.
agents.export.generated_unknown: Generated by wev agent export. Do not edit by hand.
agents.error.ceiling_unset: {field}: the ancestor '{ancestor}' sets a permission ceiling and a descendant cannot unset it
agents.error.tool_profile: Unknown tool profile '{profile}'; use auto, structured or lean.
agents.cmd.tool_profile: Tool profile for the exported agents: structured (full allow list), lean (shell plus minimal read and edit tools for agents that edit) or auto (lean for premium-tier agents). Default: harness.tool_profile from the configuration.
agents.error.widen_tool: {field}: the ancestor '{ancestor}' sets a permission ceiling and does not allow the tool '{tool}'; a descendant may narrow the tools but not add to them
agents.error.builtin_shadow: Agent id '{id}' belongs to the built-in catalog and {file} may not redefine it; choose another id or set agents.allow_override in the configuration
agents.error.number_range: must be a finite number not above {maximum}
agents.error.invalid_budget: Refusing to export budget.max_units {value}: it must be a finite number not above {maximum}
agents.error.output_outside: Refusing to write {path}: it is outside the repository root {root}
agents.error.output_state: Refusing to write {path}: it is inside the state directory of {root}
agents.error.output_forbidden: Refusing to write {path}: nothing is written into .git or .claude under {root}, except that agent export may write <id>.md files into .claude/agents
agents.error.output_symlink: Refusing to write into {path}: it is a symbolic link, and the exporter does not follow links out of {root}
agents.error.output_notdir: Refusing to write into {path}: it exists and is not a directory
agents.error.output_protected: Refusing to write {path}: it is a protected path of {root}
agents.error.output_unreadable: Refusing to write into {path}: the directory cannot be listed
agents.error.case_collision: Refusing to write {path}: '{existing}' already exists there and differs only by case
agents.error.not_json_file: Refusing to write {path}: an agent spec file must end in .json
agents.error.not_agent_spec: Refusing to overwrite {path}: it exists and is not an agent spec
agents.error.not_generated_file: Refusing to overwrite {path}: it exists and was not generated by wev agent export
agents.error.reserved_name: Refusing to write an agent spec to {path}: {name} is the name of the engine's configuration file. Choose another file name.
